svg.text: Figure 1 · Every wiki page and where it comes from
127 pages: 75 copied from repository pages by build_wiki.py, 13 written by other generators, 39 hand-written here. 74 are in the sidebar; 0 are reached neither from the sidebar nor from
Not in the sidebar (filled: in the sidebar)
The number on each page is how many other wiki pages link to it.

Generated by tools/figures/wiki_readme.py from the pages in docs/wiki, its sidebar and assets list, and the publish workflow. Publishing a page is not a review: nothing on the wiki is verified or accepted by being there (rule R13).

g.text: Terms: DoD = US Department of Defense · MIL-STD-882E = US DoD Standard Practice for System Safety (11 May 2012, base edition) · PX4 = PX4 Autopilot, the open-source flight-control software candidate for SUS-A1 · R01 … =

validator rule in tools/pdac (R13 = only a named human review accepts anything) · SUS-A1 = dockable observation UAV · SUS-I1 = integrated mechanized walker and observation UAV · SUS-M1 = piloted walker · SysML = Systems
Modeling Language (SysML v2) · UAV = uncrewed aerial vehicle (drone) · US = United States · V-nnn = SysML view (tools/sysml/views.py)
